description: Measured offline-suite line-coverage floor for the packages listed under packages. Floor is measured_percent - epsilon. Do not lower floor_percent without an explicit --allow-lower review; raise it only after a clean offline measurement.
measured_command: python -m pytest -m 'not network and not benchmark' --cov=src --cov-report=json:coverage.json
notes: Measured from the local offline suite on 2026-08-17 after 11,622 selected tests (5 skipped, 24 deselected); floor = measured - 0.5pt epsilon. Working-tree floor_percent must not fall below origin/main (see check_coverage_floor.py anti-lowering); intentional lowers require COVERAGE_FLOOR_ALLOW_LOWER_VS_MAIN=1 and an explicit review.
